context: Private formative challenge for mixed software developers, followed by separate named-role validation. Candidate task-local semantics only.
goal: Prepare the current candidate meanings for the engineer-assessment research product and MVP software.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A formula alone does not validate what a score means.
Changing weights, transformations or missingness rules creates a new score version.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One score version and compatible role, cases, rubrics and modes.
working_meaning.statement: A Scoring Specification is a versioned rule set mapping elicited Criterion Ratings and declared missingness to session and optional composite scores, uncertainty and permitted interpretations for one declared formative or role-linked purpose.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Rater agreement alone is not total score uncertainty.
An interval estimated with multiple research cases cannot be applied to a one-case product without a design study.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One score version, population and intended decision.
working_meaning.statement: Measurement Uncertainty is the estimated range or decision instability of a score arising from sampled cases, raters, response modes, transcription and model fit under a named measurement design.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Results on the Calibration Set are development evidence, not held-out validation.
A response used to tune a model cannot later become untouched test evidence for that model.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One development phase and pinned score version.
working_meaning.statement: A Calibration Set is a versioned collection of responses and ratings assigned before validation to train raters, refine anchors, fit permitted scoring parameters and find failure cases.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Repeated inspection and retuning destroys holdout status.
A participant split alone does not test transfer to new case families or employers.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One preregistered validation comparison.
working_meaning.statement: A Validation Holdout is a preassigned participant, case-family, employer or time slice whose outcome labels and responses do not influence case, rubric, scorer, weights or analysis choices before its locked evaluation.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: An observed sample statistic is an estimate, not the estimand itself.
Top-capacity utility for all applicants is not identified from hired-only outcomes without additional design and assumptions.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One registered hypothesis or decision comparison.
working_meaning.statement: An Estimand is the exact population-level quantity a study intends to learn, specifying population, outcome, policies or conditions compared, capacity, time horizon and treatment of missing outcomes before estimating it.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Unreleased wording does not prove an unrehearsed reasoning pattern.
Self-reported familiarity is incomplete evidence of exposure.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One case family or version and recruitment population.
working_meaning.statement: Case Exposure is a versioned record of where and when a case or its underlying solution mechanism may have been seen, practiced, shared or leaked by a population, including uncertainty about that history.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A display percentile or convenient cut point is not an authorized threshold.
A threshold does not transfer across changed cases, scorers, modes or populations without bridging evidence.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One authorized policy version.
working_meaning.statement: A Decision Threshold is a predeclared boundary in a specified score and uncertainty scale that a Decision Policy may use for an action, justified for one role, population and capacity with an explicit review or abstention region.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Knowing a riddle's familiar answer is not evidence of analytical reasoning by itself.
A session rating cannot establish a stable general reasoning trait without cross-case evidence.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Session 1 tasks and role-linked independent work criteria.
working_meaning.statement: Analytical Reasoning is the case-bounded ability to represent supplied facts and constraints, distinguish assumptions from evidence, compare causal explanations and test whether a proposed conclusion follows.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Original wording, many ideas or surprising but unusable proposals do not suffice.
The assessment cannot claim broad workplace creativity without transfer evidence.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Session 1 tasks and independent creative engineering work.
working_meaning.statement: Creative Reasoning is the case-bounded production and evaluation of a non-obvious approach that is useful under the stated goal and constraints, judged for quality rather than answer quantity or rarity alone.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A trick answer without an explained mechanism is insufficient.
Ingenuity may overlap with creative and analytical reasoning; distinctness is a hypothesis to test.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Session 1 tasks with a fair opportunity to reframe or adapt.
working_meaning.statement: Ingenuity is a case-bounded, feasible change in framing, mechanism or use of available resources that resolves a constraint while preserving the goal.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A spoken design is not evidence of coding or implementation throughput.
Familiar architecture vocabulary without causal fit to requirements does not meet the construct.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Session 2 cases and independently rated engineering design work.
working_meaning.statement: Technical and Product Design Judgment is role-level reasoning that translates user goals and engineering constraints into a coherent software design, explains quality-attribute tradeoffs and operating risks, and revises the design when requirements change.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Stating the socially approved answer does not establish cooperative behavior.
Cooperation does not require yielding when that would breach a safety, fairness or user constraint.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Session 3 hypothetical cases and comparison with observed coordination.
working_meaning.statement: Cooperation Judgment is case-bounded reasoning about other parties' incentives, mutual commitments, allocation of work and credit, conflict repair and adaptation to a counterparty response.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Accent, speaking speed, confidence and social style are not substitutes for message content.
A polished hypothetical message is not proof of later workplace communication behavior.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Session 3 work cases and observed team coordination criteria.
working_meaning.statement: Communication Judgment is the case-bounded quality of a proposed message or explanation in making relevant facts, requests, commitments, uncertainty and next steps understandable to the intended collaborators.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: There is no universal best-engineer label in this model.
An assessment rank or hiring decision cannot define its own successful outcome.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One validation claim with fixed role, outcome and threshold.
working_meaning.statement: A High-Performing Engineer is a person whose independently observed, opportunity-aware performance meets a predeclared Target Outcome standard for one Engineering Role Profile, population and time horizon.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A generated prompt is not an approved Case Version.
Novel wording does not establish independent reasoning pattern, solvability or equivalent difficulty.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: Case-bank development, not live scoring or release.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Generator is a pinned human- or machine-assisted procedure that proposes candidate case prompts and scoring blueprints from declared construct, role, case grammar, constraints and forbidden exposure patterns.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Bank inclusion does not mean a case is eligible for scored administration.
Restricted cases and answers cannot be treated as public challenge content by default.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One product and research program version.
working_meaning.statement: An Item Bank is a governed inventory of candidate, released, held-out and retired Case Families and Case Versions with identity, exposure, lineage, access and lifecycle records.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: An automated similarity score is not proof of case equivalence or uniqueness.
Case quality does not establish candidate-score reliability or job prediction.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One case version and intended population or administration context.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Evaluation is a versioned pre-release or monitoring assessment of a Case Version against declared construct coverage, answerability, alternative solutions, difficulty, repetition, exposure, accessibility and timing criteria.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Agreement with human ratings is not sufficient evidence of construct or predictive validity.
A scorer that matches aggregate distributions may still miss unusual valid answers or create subgroup error.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One scoring version and compatible cases, rubrics and response modes.
working_meaning.statement: A Scorer Evaluation is a versioned test of a pinned human or automated scoring procedure against independent anchored ratings, evidence spans, adversarial responses, mode changes and downstream criteria under a declared population and use.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: The challenge is not a validated hiring selection procedure.
A challenge release does not itself authorize participant data collection.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One MVP challenge release and eligible audience.
working_meaning.statement: A Developer Challenge is the participant-facing, versioned offer of practice, up to three scored case sessions and purpose-limited provisional feedback under one declared administration and data-use protocol.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: An invitation is not research permission.
Redeeming an invitation does not prove eligibility or complete enrollment.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One recruitment event and participant entry route.
working_meaning.statement: An Invitation is a one-use, versioned offer to an eligible person to enter a specified Challenge and Study Protocol, recording source channel and redemption state without assigning a score.

originating_intent: Define every critical assessment and MVP software concept before implementation and participant collection.
